values.text: Let’s make a video in 4 easy steps!

Hey {{first_name}}! Thanks for signing up for Clipcraft.

If you want an easy way to make great videos, you’re in the right place. Look out for video tips, tutorials and ideas from our team, starting with this email.

Read on to make a video in just four simple steps.
Pick from our templates for everything from birthday wishes to product launches, or start from scratch.
Add your images, illustrations and videos in a few ways:
From your computer: drag and drop files, or upload from cloud storage.
From your phone: scan a code, choose photos and clips, and add them with a tap.
From your team: send a private upload link so others can add media.
Drag your photos and videos into your media blocks. Try layouts that put two clips side by side.

values.altText: A video editor with a colour palette

values.text:
Keep it simple with a ready-made theme, or change the text, colours, music and animation style.

And just like that, you have a great video!

values.preheaderText: Pick a template, add your media, drag and drop, make it yours.
